Management Plan

- Urgent referral to neurology for assessment and brain imaging to rule out multiple sclerosis or other neurological pathology.  
- No medications initiated; advised that disease-modifying therapy (e.g., steroids) would be considered only after firm diagnosis.

- Continue current OTC analgesia (ibuprofen) as needed for musculoskeletal pain.  
- Follow-up: Await neurology appointment; patient to contact clinic if interim concerns arise.
